title: Hoodlum Soldier Ep 1: The Choice

scenes.say: Newark, New Jersey. Streetlights flicker. Gunshots echo, and nobody even looks up.
scenes.visual: a cracked Newark street at night, flickering sodium streetlights, wet asphalt, distant police glow, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Seventeen-year-old Ali Torres sits low in a parked Cutlass. Hood up. Jaw tight.
scenes.visual: a teenager in a black hoodie seen from behind, slumped low in an old parked Cutlass at night, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: A scar over his eye. A thirty-eight in his lap.
scenes.visual: close up of a revolver resting on faded jeans inside a dark car, dashboard light, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: He crosses the street to a trap house.
scenes.visual: a hooded silhouette crossing an empty street toward a run-down rowhouse porch, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: A little girl on the porch asks if he is still her brother Dre's friend.
scenes.visual: a small girl sitting on porch steps under a bare bulb, toys beside her, night, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Used to be, he says. Then he knocks twice.
scenes.visual: a fist knocking on a battered wooden door, peeling paint, harsh porch light, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Then red and blue lights flood the block.
scenes.visual: red and blue police lights washing over a row of houses, rain on the street, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Now he stands in an orange jumpsuit while his mother cries behind him.
scenes.visual: an orange jumpsuit seen from behind in a courtroom, a woman crying in the gallery, soft focus, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: The judge leans in. Two options, son. Prison, or the U.S. Army.
scenes.visual: a judge's bench and gavel in a wood-paneled courtroom, dramatic window light, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Ali looks down. Then up. And nods.
scenes.visual: a young man's clasped hands in handcuffs, light falling across them, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Follow for Episode Two. Turn negative into positive.
scenes.visual: an American flag folded on a table beside a red bandana, moody light, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

caption: HOODLUM SOLDIER, Episode 1 of 25: The Choice. The true-story series from the book by Elvin Torres Sr. New episode every 48 hours.
